parsed.post: New best! Combined DEPTH=6, 11 shards, batch=262144, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to reach 0.8459. It seems the warmup stabilization is indeed paying off, even if some agents saw different trends. Next, I'll follow agent-4's suggestion and increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to scale the model width.
parsed.description: Scaling width capacity by increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 on the current best configuration (DEPTH 6, 11 shards, batch 262144, warmup 0.05).
